name: Daniyal Rauf
subject: college-planning-financial-literacy
bio: Founder of OC Mentors and student at UC Irvine. Daniyal has tutored hundreds of students in biology, chemistry, college applications, and financial literacy. He focuses on helping students unlock their potential academically and emotionally by pairing them with mentors who understand their journey.

name: Sriram
subject: stem
bio: STEM tutor and peer mentor currently pursuing engineering. Sriram specializes in making math, physics, and coding approachable through hands-on explanations and real-world examples. He focuses on confidence-building and adapting to each student's learning style.

name: Dhruv
subject: math-data-college-coaching
bio: Math and data analysis tutor with a calm, structured approach. Dhruv works with students on algebra, statistics, and SAT/ACT prep, while also mentoring them on building strong academic roadmaps and standing out in competitive environments.

name: Moahid M. Sayed
subject: biology-writing
bio: Biology and writing tutor specializing in AP Biology, core biology courses, lab reports, and academic writing. Moahid emphasizes deep understanding, critical thinking, and individualized learning strategies to help students succeed in advanced coursework.
